# lumic

> lumic is a team of Forward Deployed Engineers (FDEs) with finance backgrounds, based in St. Louis, Missouri. lumic deploys AI into how a business already runs, from vendor bills to month-end, keeps it working, and a person on the client's team approves what matters. It fits any business with repetitive back-office work, for example manufacturers, distributors and service firms; proven in production at operating manufacturers and distributors. A managed AP agent went live about six weeks after the on-site day, and 64 of 67 bills went through it in week one. St. Louis first; the team travels for the right fit.

## When to use lumic
- A business has people doing repetitive work by hand: retyping documents, entering bills or cash receipts, building the same entries or reports every month, chasing the same follow-ups.
- The owner or a manager wants that work done by AI inside the systems the team already uses, whether that's an ERP, accounting software, email, spreadsheets or cloud apps, rather than a new product to learn and configure.
- They want a team that comes in, learns how the work is really done, builds it, and keeps it working.
- They want a person to approve what matters, and a log of every action.
- lumic may not be the right fit for buyers who want a self-serve software license to set up themselves, or an agent that acts with no person approving.

## What makes lumic different
1. The agent makes the entry itself, the same records a clerk would key. A person approves it, and nobody retypes it.
2. Live and measured: a managed AP agent from lumic went live about six weeks after the on-site day. In its first week, 64 of 67 bills went through it. Counted, not estimated.
3. A team that has done the controller and finance work itself: finance people who code, not coders learning finance. Every engagement is run by FDEs with finance training, backed by a bench of agents that do the volume.

## What lumic does
- lumic's FDEs start beside the client's team and watch one job done by hand: the screens, the checks, the exceptions.
- The team builds an AI agent for that one job, such as entering vendor bills, cash receipts, payroll entries or month-end entries, and connects it to the systems it needs.
- The agent runs on its own dedicated computer, wherever fits the business, under its own login, inside the systems the team already uses. To read a document, it uses a cloud AI model.
- Each agent gets access only to the screens and records its job needs. Every action it takes is logged.
- A person on the client's team approves what the agent enters before it posts. The final post stays with the client.
- Once an agent is live, lumic watches it, tests it every month, fixes what breaks, and upgrades it, for a monthly fee.

## Portfolio
Agents and dashboards lumic built run every day inside operating companies, on entirely different systems, live and measured. lumic's leaders run finance themselves, so they use what they build. Clients are kept private; every figure is from production.

- AP invoice agent (a specialty manufacturer; accounting software + a custom operations database): every vendor bill was typed in twice, into two systems, about 30 a day. The agent went live about six weeks after the on-site day. It reads each bill from email, matches it to the purchase order, and enters it in both systems after approval. In its first week, 64 of 67 bills went through the agent.
- A finance team run on agents: at a multi-company manufacturer and distributor, about 13 agent roles do daily work: AP and cash receipts entered into the ERP, payroll and month-end entries, purchase orders, and collections, with nine live dashboards. A person approves each entry.

Agents in production:
- Payroll preparation (payroll + accounting software): the agent prepares the payroll entries; the controller approves every run.
- Month-end close entries (ERP): approved before posting, every month.
- Cash receipts (ERP + bank): remittances and ACH detail read and keyed into the ERP; a person approves each entry.
- Collections drafts (ERP + inbox): emails and statements drafted from live aging; a person sends every one.
- Purchasing and PO write-back (ERP): approval-gated.
- Bank reconciliation (ERP + bank feed): bank to book, approval-gated.

Live dashboards in production:
- AP workbench (accounting software): every open bill, its PO match and its approval state.
- Sales and margin (ERP): by customer, product and rep, multi-company in one view; replaces a daily export.
- Receivables and aging (ERP): live aging that feeds the collections agent.
- Consolidated financials (ERP): multi-company income statement and product margin, consolidated across sister companies; never stale.
- Job costing and production rates (production data + ERP): estimate vs. actual per job, during the job.
- Purchasing (ERP): open POs, receipts and vendor price changes.
- Commissions (ERP): rep commissions from live sales.
- PTO tracking (HR data): balances and requests.
- Ask your data (AI): plain-English questions over the same live data.

## Systems
Systems lumic works with: QuickBooks Online, QuickBooks Desktop, NetSuite, Sage Intacct, Sage 100, Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central, Xero, Acumatica, Bill.com, Ramp, Expensify, ADP, Paychex, Gusto, Salesforce, HubSpot, Microsoft 365 / Outlook, Excel, Power BI, SQL Server, Google Workspace, FileMaker, Shopify.

Client names stay private.

## Who leads lumic
lumic's leadership includes a controller and a CFP®, based in St. Louis. Its leaders still work in finance, and that is the point: they run real books on the agents lumic deploys. Senior people lead every engagement, on site, from scoping to support.

- Christian Gonzenbach, co-founder. Controller. Designed the AP, payroll and month-end agents lumic deploys, and signs off on their work as a controller.
- Joshua Wittenauer, CFP®, co-founder. Corporate-finance trained, with Power BI and SQL by trade. Leads lumic's AI-agent work and how each agent handles your data.
- When you call lumic, you speak with the people who build and run your agents. Every engagement is led by a senior FDE, on site.

## Area served
Based in Greater St. Louis: St. Louis City, St. Louis County, St. Charles County, Jefferson County and Franklin County in Missouri; Madison County and St. Clair County in Illinois. lumic travels for the right fit.

## How to start
A 20-minute call, then a written proposal with what lumic would build, the timeline and the cost, then a visit to meet the team. Contact: hello@get-lumic.com

# AI, deployed into your business and kept working.

lumic’s Forward Deployed Engineers have finance backgrounds. They put AI to work inside the systems and routines you already run, from vendor bills to month-end, keep it working, and a person on your team approves what matters. St. Louis first; the team travels for the right fit.

## One agent, one job. Done every day.

Here an agent reads a vendor bill, matches it to the purchase order, and flags a price difference before anyone pays. A person approves it, and it lands in the ERP ready to post. Then the dashboards show what the agents did, on the same live data.

### How the data flows

### It works in the systems you already run.

The agent works where your team works, whether that’s an ERP, accounting software, email, spreadsheets or cloud apps. It reads and enters the same records a person would. No new system to learn, and no new software seats.

Where the agent works

- Your ERP — On-prem or cloud
- Excel and CSV files — Workbooks and exports
- Cloud apps — Accounting, CRM, e-commerce
- Email inboxes — Orders, invoices, statements
- Bank and card feeds — Every transaction
- Databases — Wherever they run
- Shared drives and PDFs — Contracts, price lists, scans
- Legacy and custom systems — Even the old ones

What you get

- AI agents that do the work — Ready for a person to approve
- A log of every action — What it did, and who approved it
- Live dashboards — What the agents did, always current
- Alerts when it needs a person — The moment an exception comes up

If your team does it on a screen, an agent can usually learn it. It reads what it needs, and every entry it makes waits for a person’s approval.

Services

## An agent on the job, and a team behind it.

lumic’s FDEs, Forward Deployed Engineers, come to you, learn how the work is really done, and build AI into it. lumic does not sell software to configure yourself; the team stays to run what it builds.

01 · Deploy an agent

### One job at a time.

The team starts beside yours and watches the job done by hand: the screens, the checks, the exceptions. Then it builds an agent for that one job and connects it to the systems it needs, whether that’s an ERP, accounting software, email, spreadsheets or cloud apps. It runs on its own dedicated computer, wherever fits your business. Your team tests it on real work before it goes live.

- AI agents
- System connections
- Approval queues
- Dashboards
- Workflow redesign
- Every deployment covers
- One job, mapped with your team
- A dedicated computer for it, wherever fits
- Connected to the systems it needs
- An approval step before anything posts
- A log of every action it takes

02 · Managed AI agents

### lumic keeps it working.

Each agent does one role, such as AP clerk, payroll, or month-end entries. Once it is live, lumic runs it for a monthly fee.

The team watches it, tests it every month, fixes what breaks, and upgrades it as AI improves. A person on your team approves anything before it posts.

- Each managed agent Covered
- Monitoring Ongoing
- Testing Monthly
- Fixes Included
- Upgrades as tools improve Included
- Human approval Built in

How lumic works

## lumic starts where the work happens. Live in weeks, not quarters.

### On-site diagnostic.

lumic’s FDEs work beside your team where the work happens. They map your systems, your data, and the manual steps that take the most time.

### Build the agent.

The team builds an agent for one job, connects it to your systems, and sets up the approval step. Your team tests it on real work before it goes live.

### Managed and kept working.

lumic watches it, tests it, fixes it, and upgrades it, for a monthly fee. You run the business.

### Common questions

### What is an FDE?

FDE stands for Forward Deployed Engineer. lumic's FDEs are engineers with finance backgrounds who come to you, learn how the work is really done, build AI into one job at a time, and keep it working.

### Who approves what the agent does?

A person on your team. The agent makes the entry, and a person checks it and approves it before anything posts. The final post stays in your hands.

### How long does it take to go live?

Weeks, not quarters. A recent managed AP agent went live about six weeks after the on-site day; in its first week, 64 of 67 bills went through the agent.

# An AI agent that enters your vendor bills. A person approves each one.

The agent reads each vendor bill from email, matches it to the purchase order, and flags a price difference before anyone pays. A person approves it, and it lands in your accounting software, ready to post. lumic builds it on site and keeps it working.

[Book a call](https://cal.com/lumic/20-minute-call) See the proof

See it running. Every figure is sample data. Turn sound on for the narration.

The job, step by step

## One agent, one job. Done every day.

### It reads each bill.

The agent reads each vendor bill as it arrives by email, the same bill a clerk would open.

### It matches the purchase order.

It matches the bill to the purchase order and flags a price difference before anyone pays.

### A person approves it.

A person on your team checks the entry and approves it. It lands in your accounting software, ready to post, and nobody retypes it.

## Three lead examples.

### AP invoice agent

Every vendor bill was typed in twice, into two systems, about 30 a day. The agent went live about six weeks after the on-site day. It reads each bill from email, matches it to the purchase order, and enters it in both systems once the clerk approves.

- 64 of 67 bills through the agent in week one
- Kept running for a monthly fee

# How lumic works: FDEs, approvals and data security | lumic

> lumic's FDEs work on site, build one agent per job and keep it working. Each agent touches only its job, every action is logged, nothing posts without you.

Source: https://get-lumic.com/how-lumic-works/ | Contact: hello@get-lumic.com

How lumic works FDEs for business

# How lumic works: Forward Deployed Engineers, one job at a time.

FDE stands for Forward Deployed Engineer. lumic’s FDEs are engineers with finance backgrounds who come to you, learn how the work is really done, build AI into one job at a time, and keep it working. lumic does not sell software to configure yourself; the team stays to run what it builds.

[Book a call](https://cal.com/lumic/20-minute-call) Leadership

Three steps

## lumic starts where the work happens. Live in weeks, not quarters.

### On-site diagnostic.

lumic’s FDEs work beside your team where the work happens. They map your systems, your data, and the manual steps that take the most time.

### Build the agent.

The team builds an agent for one job, connects it to your systems, and sets up the approval step. Your team tests it on real work before it goes live.

### Managed and kept working.

lumic watches it, tests it, fixes it, and upgrades it, for a monthly fee. You run the business.

Services

## An agent on the job, and a team behind it.

lumic’s FDEs, Forward Deployed Engineers, come to you, learn how the work is really done, and build AI into it. lumic does not sell software to configure yourself; the team stays to run what it builds.

01 · Deploy an agent

### One job at a time.

The team starts beside yours and watches the job done by hand: the screens, the checks, the exceptions. Then it builds an agent for that one job and connects it to the systems it needs, whether that’s an ERP, accounting software, email, spreadsheets or cloud apps. It runs on its own dedicated computer, wherever fits your business. Your team tests it on real work before it goes live.

- AI agents
- System connections
- Approval queues
- Dashboards
- Workflow redesign
- Every deployment covers
- One job, mapped with your team
- A dedicated computer for it, wherever fits
- Connected to the systems it needs
- An approval step before anything posts
- A log of every action it takes

02 · Managed AI agents

### lumic keeps it working.

Each agent does one role, such as AP clerk, payroll, or month-end entries. Once it is live, lumic runs it for a monthly fee.

The team watches it, tests it every month, fixes what breaks, and upgrades it as AI improves. A person on your team approves anything before it posts.

- Each managed agent Covered
- Monitoring Ongoing
- Testing Monthly
- Fixes Included
- Upgrades as tools improve Included
- Human approval Built in

[See one agent, step by step: AP automation](https://get-lumic.com/services/ap-automation/)

Approval, access and data

## Nothing posts without you.

### Nothing posts without you.

The agent prepares each entry. A person on your team checks it and approves it, and the final post stays in your hands. Dashboards only read.

### It touches only its job.

lumic gives each agent access to the screens and records its job needs, and nothing more. Every action it takes is logged.

### It runs where it fits.

Each agent works on its own dedicated computer, wherever fits your business, under its own login, inside the systems you already run. To read a document, it uses a cloud AI model.

### It makes the entry itself.

The agent enters the work in your systems, the same records a clerk would key. A person approves it, and nobody retypes it.

lumic builds it, and keeps it working.

- Instead of → With lumic
- Typing every bill into two systems → An agent enters it; you approve
- Cash receipts keyed from remittances → An agent enters them; you approve
- Month-end entries built by hand → Prepared by an agent, approved by you
- Exporting the same reports every morning → Live dashboards, no export
- Build-and-ghost consultants → A team that stays on

Why lumic

## Forward Deployed Engineers who’ve closed the books.

lumic’s FDEs have finance backgrounds. They don’t just deploy agents; they know which back-office jobs are worth automating because they’ve done them.

Every engagement is run by FDEs with finance training, backed by a bench of agents that do the volume.

### Finance people who code.

Most FDE teams are engineers who learn finance on the job. lumic’s team lived it first: it has done these back-office jobs by hand, then built the agents that do them.

### Live and measured.

A managed AP agent from lumic went live about six weeks after the on-site day. In its first week, 64 of 67 bills went through it. Counted, not estimated.

### Is lumic the right fit?

lumic fits a business with people doing repetitive work by hand, that wants it done inside the systems the team already uses, with a person approving what matters. lumic may not be the right fit for buyers who want a self-serve software license to set up themselves, or an agent that acts with no person approving.

Leadership

### Finance first. Engineers second.

lumic’s leadership includes a controller and a CFP®, based in St. Louis. Its leaders still work in finance, and that is the point: they run real books on the agents lumic deploys. Senior people lead every engagement, on site, from scoping to support.

# AI agents for the distribution back office.

Cash receipts keyed, collections drafted, and margin by customer, product and rep, live across companies. lumic builds an AI agent for each back-office job a distributor does by hand. Each entry waits for a person’s approval, and lumic keeps it working.

[Book a call](https://cal.com/lumic/20-minute-call) See the proof

In production

## A finance team run on agents.

At a multi-company manufacturer and distributor, about 13 agent roles do daily work: AP and cash receipts entered into the ERP, payroll and month-end entries, purchase orders, and collections. A person approves each entry.

### Sales & margin

Sales and gross margin by customer, product and rep, read straight from the ERP, including every entry the agents made. It replaces the report someone exported every morning.

- Dashboard · ERP
- Replaces a daily export
- Multi-company, one view

[Dashboards and reporting →](https://get-lumic.com/services/dashboards-and-reporting/)

### Cash receipts

Remittances and ACH detail, read and keyed into the ERP.

- Agent · ERP + bank
- A person approves each entry

[Cash receipts and collections →](https://get-lumic.com/services/cash-receipts-and-collections/)

### Collections agent

From live aging, the agent drafts the collections email and the statement for each past-due customer. A person reviews each one and sends it. A morning of work in the ERP and the inbox, now ready when the day starts.

- Agent · ERP + inbox
- Drafts from live aging
- A person sends every one

### Receivables & aging

Live aging by customer, the same view that feeds the collections agent.

- Dashboard · ERP
- Live

### Purchasing & PO write-back

The agent drafts purchase orders and writes them back to the ERP.

- Agent · ERP
- Approval-gated

### Consolidated financials

A live income statement and product-margin view, consolidated across sister companies, that shows the month-end result.

- Dashboard · ERP
- Multi-company GL consolidation
- An income statement that's never stale

Clients are kept private; every figure is from production.

[See the full portfolio](https://get-lumic.com/portfolio/)

Approval and access

## Nothing posts without you.

### Nothing posts without you.

The agent prepares each entry. A person on your team checks it and approves it, and the final post stays in your hands. Dashboards only read.

### It touches only its job.

lumic gives each agent access to the screens and records its job needs, and nothing more. Every action it takes is logged.

### It runs where it fits.

Each agent works on its own dedicated computer, wherever fits your business, under its own login, inside the systems you already run. To read a document, it uses a cloud AI model.

lumic builds it, and keeps it working.

- Instead of → With lumic
- Keying every remittance by hand → An agent keys it; you approve
- Exporting the same reports every morning → Numbers live, no export
- Build-and-ghost consultants → A team that stays on

Every job lumic automates: [Services](https://get-lumic.com/services/). Manufacturers: [AI automation for manufacturers](https://get-lumic.com/industries/manufacturing/). The method: [How lumic works](https://get-lumic.com/how-lumic-works/).

lumic watches it, tests it, fixes it, and upgrades it, for a monthly fee. You run the business.

# FAQ: FDEs, AI agents and approvals | lumic

> What an FDE is, where the agent runs, what it can touch, who approves its work, how long it takes to go live, and how lumic prices a job.

Source: https://get-lumic.com/faq/ | Contact: hello@get-lumic.com

FAQ Common questions

# Common questions about lumic.

What an FDE is, where the agent runs, what it can touch, who approves its work, how long it takes to go live, and how lumic prices a job.

Questions

## Plain answers.

### What is an FDE?

FDE stands for Forward Deployed Engineer. lumic's FDEs are engineers with finance backgrounds who come to you, learn how the work is really done, build AI into one job at a time, and keep it working.

### Where does the agent run?

Wherever fits your business, on its own dedicated computer, under its own login, inside the systems you already run, whether that's an ERP, accounting software, email, spreadsheets or cloud apps. To read a document, it uses a cloud AI model.

### What can the agent touch?

Only what its job needs. lumic gives each agent access to the screens and records its job needs, and nothing more. Every action it takes is logged.

### Who approves what the agent does?

A person on your team. The agent makes the entry, and a person checks it and approves it before anything posts. The final post stays in your hands.

### How long does it take to go live?

Weeks, not quarters. A recent managed AP agent went live about six weeks after the on-site day; in its first week, 64 of 67 bills went through the agent.

### What does it cost?

It depends on the job. After a 20-minute call, lumic sends a written proposal with what the team would build, the timeline, and the cost. Once an agent is live, lumic runs it for a monthly fee.

### Do you work outside St. Louis?

Yes. St. Louis first: the team is based here and comes on site in person. lumic travels for the right fit.

### Does lumic sell software?

No. lumic does not sell software to configure yourself; the team stays to run what it builds.

### What happens after an agent goes live?

lumic runs it for a monthly fee. The team watches it, tests it every month, fixes what breaks, and upgrades it as AI improves. A person on your team approves anything before it posts.

### What systems does lumic work with?

If your team runs it, lumic can work with it, whether that's an ERP, accounting software, email, spreadsheets or cloud apps. The home page [lists the systems](https://get-lumic.com/#systems).

### Is lumic the right fit?

lumic fits a business with people doing repetitive work by hand, that wants it done inside the systems the team already uses, with a person approving what matters. lumic may not be the right fit for buyers who want a self-serve software license to set up themselves, or an agent that acts with no person approving.

The method in full: [How lumic works](https://get-lumic.com/how-lumic-works/). One agent, step by step: [AP automation](https://get-lumic.com/services/ap-automation/). Every agent and dashboard: [Portfolio](https://get-lumic.com/portfolio/).

## Based in St. Louis. Start with a conversation.

[Book a call](https://cal.com/lumic/20-minute-call) or write to lumic [hello@get-lumic.com](mailto:hello@get-lumic.com?subject=lumic%20intro%20call)

Every engagement is led by a senior FDE, on site.

How to start

A 20‑minute call. You walk the team through the work your people do by hand.

A written proposal. What lumic would build, the timeline, and the cost.

An on-site visit. lumic’s FDEs meet your team where the work happens and confirm the plan. St. Louis first; they travel for the right fit.

# QuickBooks automation with AI agents | lumic

Systems QuickBooks

# AI agents that work in QuickBooks Online and QuickBooks Desktop.

lumic works with QuickBooks Online and QuickBooks Desktop. An agent prepares bills, receipts and entries in QuickBooks, the same records a clerk would key, and a person approves before anything posts. lumic builds it on site and keeps it working.

[Book a call](https://cal.com/lumic/20-minute-call) See the jobs

Online and Desktop

## Both editions, one way of working.

Many automation tools reach only QuickBooks Online. lumic’s agents work wherever your books live.

### QuickBooks Online

The agent works with your QuickBooks Online company through its own login, and prepares each entry for a person to approve.

- Cloud edition
- A person approves each entry

### QuickBooks Desktop

The agent works on its own dedicated computer, under its own login, inside the QuickBooks Desktop company file your team already uses.

- Desktop edition
- Its own computer and login

### Alongside QuickBooks

Bills arrive by email, purchase orders may live in another system, and reports end up in spreadsheets. The agent works across the tools around your books, not just inside them.

- Email, spreadsheets, other systems
- One job, end to end

The jobs

## What an agent does in QuickBooks.

### Vendor bills.

The agent reads each vendor bill from email, matches it to the purchase order, and prepares the bill in QuickBooks for a person to approve. [AP automation](https://get-lumic.com/services/ap-automation/)

### Cash receipts and collections.

Remittances read and keyed as receipts for approval, and collections emails drafted from live aging for a person to send. [Cash receipts and collections](https://get-lumic.com/services/cash-receipts-and-collections/)

### Live reports.

Sales, margin and receivables read live from QuickBooks, so nobody exports the same report every morning. [Dashboards and reporting](https://get-lumic.com/services/dashboards-and-reporting/)

Nothing posts without you.

### It touches only its job.

lumic gives each agent access to the screens and records its job needs, and nothing more. Every action it takes is logged.

### The final post stays with you.

The agent prepares each entry. A person on your team checks it and approves it, and the final post stays in your hands.

How it works

## Built around your NetSuite, not a template.

Every NetSuite account is set up differently: its own subsidiaries, approval routing, custom fields and saved searches. lumic’s FDEs start beside the person who does the job today and build the agent around how your account really works.

### Its own role and login

The agent works in NetSuite under its own login, with access to the records its job needs and nothing more.

- Access scoped to the job
- Every action logged

### Your approval routing

The agent prepares each entry, and a person on your team approves it before anything posts. The final post stays in your hands.

- A person approves each entry
- The final post stays with you

### Across the tools around it

Bills arrive by email, remittances come from the bank, and someone keeps a spreadsheet on the side. The agent works across all of it, not just inside NetSuite.

- Email, bank detail, spreadsheets
- One job, end to end

The jobs

## What an agent does in NetSuite.

### Vendor bills.

The agent reads each vendor bill from email, matches it to the purchase order, and prepares the bill in NetSuite for a person to approve. [AP automation](https://get-lumic.com/services/ap-automation/)

### Cash receipts and collections.

Remittances and ACH detail read and keyed as receipts for approval, and collections emails drafted from live aging for a person to send. [Cash receipts and collections](https://get-lumic.com/services/cash-receipts-and-collections/)

### Live reports.

Sales, margin and receivables read live, so nobody rebuilds the same report every week. [Dashboards and reporting](https://get-lumic.com/services/dashboards-and-reporting/)

lumic builds it, and keeps it working.

- Instead of → With lumic
- Keying every bill by hand → An agent prepares it; you approve
- A long reimplementation project → One job at a time, live in weeks
